desc:
(⚠️SM7 content will take some time to be added.)
We are NOT affiliated with Sr Pelo. This is a fan-made game, he can tell us what to do with this game.
(Shutdowns = Updates/Fixes) 
(⚠️Your account needs to be at least 3 Months old to play!) 
------------------------------
This is a roleplay game based on Sr Pelo's Spooky Month series! Here, you have a wide variety of characters to play as and a few secrets to discover throughout the map! 
Credits to RobloxianOACUS for the amazing thumbnails! 
 ------------------------------
📁 Update Log/Info: 
- Candy has been scattered around the map, collect them....
- The Travelling Merchant, Maskslicer, has returned, you can get to him in the portal in the area in front of the theatre.
- The 4 limited badges have came back and can be purchased with candy at the shop.
- Just know, absolutely no development time went wasted to this update, its something we re-release yearly.
(⚠️You may require a good device to run this game!)
